card.name: Inside all-caps warning headings
card.fires_on: The later pieces of long words written in all capitals, mostly in boxed warning titles or section headings in drug labels. It responds partway through or at the end of the capitalized word.

modes.label: Boxed warning titles
modes.description: Word endings inside capitalized WARNING headlines.
modes.example: WARNING: SERIOUS MENINGOCOCCAL INFE<<CTIONS>> See full prescribing information for complete boxed warning

modes.label: Other capitalized headings
modes.description: Pieces of capitalized drug names or section titles.

card.plain: It fires on the later letters of long ALL-CAPS words in warning headings on drug labels.
